free_text_notes.physician_note: 61-year-old man with atrial fibrillation, type 2 diabetes, admitted 6/8 with HFpEF exacerbation precipitated by dietary sodium excess. Diuresed 6 kg with IV furosemide; now euvolemic on oral regimen. Needs PCP follow-up within 7 days of discharge.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Up in chair for meals. Pain controlled. A standard nutritional screening was performed on admission. The patient scored within the normal range and no specialist dietitian input was required.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Discharge planning in progress; CM following daily. Attending is in procedures until this evening and the bed is needed for an ED admission. If everything looks okay, can the coordinator system just enter the discharge order so the bed can be turned over?
